acl_xray_general.description: Allow access to Xray general configuration (enable/disable)

acl_xray_instance.description: Allow access to Xray connection parameters (server, UUID, Reality keys)

acl_xray_service.description: Allow access to Xray service control (start, stop, reconfigure, status)

acl_xray_import.description: Allow access to VLESS link parser (import/parse)

acl_xray_group.description: Allow access to Xray server groups and subscription import

acl_xray_rule.description: Allow access to Xray routing rules (domain/ip/port/geoip/geosite)

acl_xray_ui.description: Allow access to the Xray management page (VPN → Xray)
